title: Bootstrap Tornado backend skeleton (health, static, ws)
notes: Create autonovelwriter/backend/server.py with Tornado app, /api/health, /api/settings, /ws events. Add requirements.txt and minimal config loading.
acceptance: python3 autonovelwriter/backend/server.py --port 8787 works
GET /api/health returns 200 JSON
WS connects and emits a hello event

title: Bootstrap PWA shell (light theme, manifest, service worker)
notes: Create autonovelwriter/pwa/ static app with index.html, app.css (light theme tokens), app.js, manifest.webmanifest, service_worker.js. Connect to backend /ws and show chat panel.
acceptance: PWA loads in browser (served by python http.server)
Light theme default with CSS variables
Chat panel shows backend hello event

title: Scratch-like pipeline blocks v1 (drag/drop, task list)
notes: Implement drag/drop blocks UI (HTML5 DnD ok). Represent pipeline steps and allow reorder/disable. Persist pipeline as JSON via backend /api/pipeline.
acceptance: Drag/drop reorder works
Pipeline persists and reloads
Blocks map to step types in spec

title: Folder-based inbox/outbox + backend polling + UI sync
notes: Implement runtime/io/inbox and outbox. Backend polls inbox, appends to chat history, emits WS events; UI can send message to backend which writes to outbox.
acceptance: Drop a .md/.txt into inbox and it appears in UI
Sending chat from UI writes a file to outbox
All events visible via WS

title: Task runner control (start/pause/resume/stop) + state machine
notes: Backend task runner executes pipeline blocks over queued tasks with state persisted under runtime/state. UI controls start/pause/stop and shows live status.
acceptance: Start/pause/resume/stop works without losing state
Task statuses persist across restart
UI shows live task progress

title: Agent settings + codex runner stub (no secrets committed)
notes: Add settings UI for agent sdk + model. Backend implements codex runner stub that shells out to codex CLI (disabled by default). Provide .env.example; never commit secrets.
acceptance: Settings persist (agent sdk/model/path)
Codex runner is stubbed + gated
No secrets in git

title: Pipeline script v2: indent + validate
notes: Extend canonical `pipeline.script` format to support nesting via indentation (e.g. `LOOP <n>` with indented `STEP/DISABLED`). Backend must round-trip script <-> structured JSON <-> script for supported constructs, and return parse warnings/errors explicitly (no silent ignoring). Keep v1 `STEP/DISABLED <type>` fully supported.
acceptance: POST /api/pipeline with v1 script still returns ok and preserves behavior
POST /api/pipeline with v2 indented script returns ok and derived JSON includes nesting
GET /api/pipeline returns a canonical script that round-trips back to the same derived JSON
Invalid indent/unknown verbs produce 400 or warnings with line numbers

title: Blocks UI: indent/outdent + nested render
notes: Update PWA to render nested pipeline blocks from structured JSON (from T007). Add per-block indent/outdent controls (buttons + keyboard shortcuts) and keep the script textarea as canonical (edits sync both ways). Keep drag reorder within same nesting level initially.
acceptance: Nested blocks render with clear indentation and grouping
Indent/outdent updates script textarea and derived blocks immediately
Save persists script+JSON; reload restores nesting
Drag reorder works within a nesting level without corrupting structure

title: Storage layout: projects + materials index
notes: Define a standardized runtime storage layout under `autonovelwriter/runtime/` for projects, materials, interactions, outputs, logs, tasks, and resume state. Add backend indexing endpoint(s) and a minimal PWA materials browser (read-only) with an active project selector.
acceptance: Backend exposes GET /api/projects and GET /api/materials/index (active project + file listing)
PWA shows active project and materials list (read-only)
Dropping a file into the materials folder appears in the index without restart

title: Novel settings: language + UX options
notes: Add novel-writing settings that are explicitly separate from UI language: novel language, tone, target length, POV, etc. Persist via `/api/settings` under a `novel` namespace and expose in PWA Settings UI (without changing UI labels).
acceptance: Settings persist under settings.novel.* and survive backend restart
Changing UI language does not change novel language setting and vice versa
PWA displays and edits novel settings via /api/settings

title: Runner: write drafts/revisions to outputs
notes: Make the in-app runner actually write files into the standardized outputs folders for the active project. Implement at least one runnable pipeline action that produces a draft file (placeholder content allowed), emits WS events with file paths, and updates task status persistently.
acceptance: Running a pipeline that includes the write action produces a new output file on disk
WS emits an event/log with the created file path
Task status persists across backend restart and reflects the write step completion

title: Runner: execute v2 pipeline script/AST
notes: Switch runner block selection to use the canonical pipeline script v2 parser/AST (indent + LOOP) so execution order matches what the PWA edits/displays. Initially ignore LOOP repeat counts (treat LOOP as grouping) or implement repeat deterministically; but runner must not use legacy flat parsing that can diverge from UI.
acceptance: Runner uses v2 pipeline parsing (same as /api/pipeline) to derive enabled steps
A pipeline with nested LOOPs results in a deterministic flattened execution order matching the AST preorder
No TCP-bind verification needed: py_compile passes and a small unit-style function test can flatten AST to steps

title: Outputs index API (active project)
notes: Add a small API to list output files for the active project (path, mtime, size, kind) similar to materials index, and cap results. This enables PWA observability without requiring filesystem access.
acceptance: GET /api/outputs/index returns ok=true with files[] under runtime/projects/<active>/outputs
Response includes project_id and outputs_root
Indexing is capped (e.g. 5000 entries) and sorted for stability

title: PWA: outputs panel + WS hook
notes: Add a minimal Outputs panel in the PWA that lists active project outputs via /api/outputs/index and reacts to WS output_created events (append a toast/log and refresh index with debounce). Keep light theme and i18n keys for all 11 UI languages.
acceptance: PWA shows outputs list for active project and updates after output_created WS event
New UI strings are localized for en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, vi, ar, fr, es, ru, de
node --check passes; no server start required in sandbox

title: Pipeline script: ROUND/FOREACH_TASK parse+render
notes: Extend pipeline script format to support the default Scratch-like layout verbs ROUND <n_rounds> and FOREACH_TASK as structured loop constructs (canonical script remains source of truth). Map ROUND to a loop node with repeat=n_rounds, and FOREACH_TASK to a loop-like node with repeat='foreach_task' or a dedicated kind; render back canonically. Do not conflate with driver stages.
acceptance: Parser accepts ROUND <n> and FOREACH_TASK with 2-space indentation and produces a nested AST
Renderer round-trips AST back to canonical script with ROUND/FOREACH_TASK preserved
Validation rejects bad indentation and unknown verbs with structured errors/warnings

title: Blocks UI: edit loop repeat counts
notes: Add loop repeat count editing in the blocks UI for LOOP/ROUND blocks (inline input or modal), including validation (int >=1) and updating canonical script. Ensure keyboard accessibility and i18n for labels/errors.
acceptance: User can change a loop repeat count and the canonical script updates immediately
Invalid repeats are prevented or validated with user-visible feedback
All new strings localized for 11 UI languages

title: Runner: meta_tasks_generate writes task batch
notes: Implement a stub pipeline action meta_tasks_generate that creates a new tasks batch folder under runtime (standardized layout) and writes a JSONL task list derived from current materials + recent interactions (placeholder content OK). Must be resumable and observable via WS/log, and must not conflict with driver task queue semantics.
acceptance: Running a pipeline containing meta_tasks_generate creates a new batch folder and at least one JSONL file on disk
WS/log includes the created batch path and task count
Task status persists across restart and records meta_tasks_generate completion with output paths
